executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to 43 missing dependency errors. The build could not find Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages. All required dependencies must be added to pom.xml to resolve these compilation failures.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be found including web.builders, web.configuration, config.http, and security.web.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple JPA repository packages cannot be found including JpaRepository, Modifying, Query, and Param annotations.
Jakarta Persistence API dependency is missing from pom.xml. Entity annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, @GeneratedValue) cannot be resolved.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add jakarta.persistence-api dependency to pom.xml: <dependency><groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId><artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId></dependency> or ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is included which transitively provides this.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. The StringUtils class cannot be found.
